verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents an AI Receptionist that can "answer and route calls on any phone system," which covers AI answering the line and routing, a plausible path to a human. Its Agentic Voice AI platform claims to automate and assist customer interactions end-to-end. However, the evidence is only thin marketing lines, and nothing documents message-taking or an explicit AI-to-human handoff. Missing for 10: documented message-taking by the AI agent, explicit escalation/handoff-to-human behavior, in-depth first-party docs on the AI Receptionist, independent or hands-on corroboration.
